title: skill eval definition (schema 4.0)
description: A skill's eval/definition.json — the one eval interface: go run ./cmd/skilleval init builds every eval and A/B run from all of it. Invocation (the skill's args as data), environment (target repo, range or checkout commit, overlay), budgets, and the skill's scoring: golden-scored (findings declaration, goldens, the golden family's scoring file — scoring rules live there, never here) or a scorer command. The evaluated skill is never modified for the eval.

invocation.description: the skill's command line as data: cmd/skilleval composes /<skill> <text> <args in order>, each arg as `name: value` or a bare flag name. The run's golden kind adds goldens[0].produce.args or goldens[0].test.args, the run's set changes only the args open names; layers merge by name. Placeholders in values: {base} {head} {exclude} {prebuilt} filled by init, {runId} {artifactsDir} {overlayPatch} {seed} by the arm runner. A definition with findings gets one appended handshake naming the artifact dir.

text.description: free text after the skill name, before the args

open.description: arg names a run may set; an open arg's declared value holds no placeholder

targetRepo.description: repo-registry name (~/.claude/smine/repos.json) of the clone the arm worktrees are cut from — a name, never a path; absent = the eval repo itself

excludePaths.description: pathspecs left out of the reviewed diff: the arm command gets them as {exclude}, the golden judge as its diff pathspec

checkoutRef.description: hex commit every arm worktree starts from; default range.headSha; its first six digits name the run dir

overlay.description: skill-dir-relative patch applied to every arm worktree

contextIndex.description: worktree-relative context index the overlay ships; the arm exports it to the context hooks as SKILL_CONTEXT_INDEX

prebuild.description: build run once in every arm worktree at provision; the arm command gets the outputs as {prebuilt}

findings.description: where a run's findings live for golden judging — the eval never imposes an output contract on the arm

glob.description: artifacts-dir-relative glob; the newest matching file is read — a cumulative ledger for a multi-round skill

arrayKey.description: top-level key of the findings array in that file; absent = the file is the array

claimKeys.description: keys tried in order for a finding's claim

scoring.description: skill-dir-relative path of the golden family's scoring.json (judge guide, severity minutes, escape multipliers, triage line, fix factors, thresholds)

budgets.description: arm ceiling — --max-budget-usd and the arm timeout — plus the usage window init's window check measures arms × armUsd against

prerequisites.description: skill-dir-relative files that must exist before a run; init refuses the run naming each missing one

goldenVersion.description: version of the golden's finding set; bumps only via re-adjudication, labels recall comparability

file.description: skill-dir-relative golden file path; the file's content is skill-owned

contextlessFile.description: skill-dir-relative contextless environment sibling of file

scope.description: scoring-scope label stamped into eval.json (default full); scores are never comparable across scopes

input.description: human description of the fixed input the golden was confirmed on

produce.description: what a golden: produce run adds

seedFile.description: skill-dir-relative known findings the runner hands to the skill; its run-dir copy fills {seed}

test.description: what a golden: test run adds

check.description: 3.1 — argv run in each arm worktree after its run; its exit code is the check_pass metric

reference.description: 3.1 — known-good commit; provision writes it as reference.patch, the A/B compare judge reads it

command.description: argv run in each arm worktree after the check; stdout is one JSON object {"metrics": {"<name>": <number>}}, names [a-z][a-z0-9_]*

scorer.description: 3.1 — the skill's own scoring when it has no golden; its metrics land in result.json scores and in eval.json as score_<name>

model.description: 3.1 — model of the declared configuration, --model verbatim; default opus

effort.description: 3.1 — effort of the declared configuration; default high

replicas.description: 3.1 — runs per eval; the eval skill's replicas arg overrides it; default 1

value.description: a string, or a list of strings joined by spaces; absent = a flag
